name: HeartMonitor
description: A pixel heart and simulated BPM counter for Geometry Dash.

hud-title.name: HeartMonitor HUD
hud-title.description: Customize the size and position of the in-game BPM panel. Changes apply when a level is entered again.

hud-scale.name: HUD size
hud-scale.description: Make the whole heart and BPM panel smaller or bigger.

hud-offset-x.name: Horizontal position
hud-offset-x.description: Move the panel left or right. Negative values move it left; positive values move it right.

hud-offset-y.name: Vertical position
hud-offset-y.description: Move the panel down or up. Negative values move it down; positive values move it up.

bpm-number-scale.name: BPM number size
bpm-number-scale.description: Change the size of the changing heart-rate number. Changes apply when a level is entered again.

bpm-unit-scale.name: BPM text size
bpm-unit-scale.description: Change the size of the BPM letters separately. Changes apply when a level is entered again.
